comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
You can get this by digging the yellow pillar spot in "Great Pyramid of Giza" legacy site (not the regular Giza inland), and also "Halicarnassus" legacy site. This will be required on Sophia Awakening recipes related to those.

It looks like it's the most common item so far (well beside Rocks but it's not item). Was able to get up to 5 in one visit.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Also used in this recipe book:

Making Mercenary Clothes - Bremen Item Shop; Required World Clock Age: 15C 4, 15C 5 or Age Effect Item (15C or 16C)

Skills: R15 Sewing / R13 Alchemy
Ingredients: Luxury Flax Yarn x1 + Ancient Iron Meteorite x1 + Axe Fragment x1
Result: Custom Flax Yarn

wiki:
Obtained in the following Legacy zones, using Search in special light pillars:

Great Pyramid of Giza (10 spots)
Halicarnassus (10 spots)
エフェソスのアルテミス神殿 (10 spots)
ロードス島の巨像頭部 (6 spots)
ロードス島の巨像足元 (10 spots)
オリンピアのゼウス神殿 (10 spots)
ファロス島 (10 spots)
アレクサンドリア大灯台 (4 spots)
イシュタル門 (10 spots)
バビロンの空中庭園 (10 spots)

Guide: Each light pillar can only yield a single item per visit to the Legacy zones. Higher ranks of Search skill decreases the opportunity to find this item as other items may be discovered instead.

However, with R1-5 Search skill, the chances of locating this item are 100% in Giza, Halicarnassus, Ephesus and Olympia zones! For the rest, it is only 50% as Spare Sail Arrangement Set items can also be found.

If you wish to collect many of these items easily, try to focus on the legacy zones without Spare Sail Arrangement items and also consider mentoring players of lower adventure levels with no Search skill; this can help lower your own Search skill temporarily.
